ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the individuals involved, the amount of money misappropriated, and the impact on the community.
questions: Who was involved in the scheme?
What was the impact on the community?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme highlights the need for better oversight and monitoring of programs meant to help vulnerable populations.

ideas.title: The Impact of the Minnesota Office of Inspector General
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of the newly proposed Minnesota Office of Inspector General on fraud prevention in the state.
questions: What powers will the Office of Inspector General have?
What is the expected impact on the state's fraud prevention efforts?
ideas.insight: The Minnesota Office of Inspector General is expected to have a significant impact on fraud prevention in the state, but its effectiveness remains to be seen.
